translations.answer: Record the arm posture, continuous joint torque and temperature at the hip and ankle/foot joints; the comment suggests placing the arms behind the waist to reduce static load, but no A/B data is available. Validation before application should include temperature guarding and small posture scans.
translations.applicability: Single-comment experience, robot version and controller unknown.
translations.credibility.rationale: Environmental, processing steps, and results have engineering records, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is missing.

translations.details.problem_statements.0: The G1 Whole-Body Teleoperation experiences excessive heat in foot joints during long-standing scenarios.
